subject.title: fix(ui): show run failures above composer

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed Control UI contract that terminal run failures are a neutral composer-adjacent alert rather than assistant transcript content, while retaining genuine partial assistant output?
rationale: The patch is a cross-boundary behavior change in Gateway event projection and Control UI conversation presentation; the author is a repository MEMBER and the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label, so automated cleanup must not substitute for an explicit maintainer merge decision.

options.title: Approve the alert contract
options.body: Merge after a maintainer confirms that terminal failure text must stay outside assistant transcript history while streamed assistant output remains visible.

options.title: Request a narrower presentation contract
options.body: Keep the PR open if maintainers want a different error placement, dismissal policy, or diagnostic disclosure model before merging the Gateway/UI changes.

recommendation.title: Approve the alert contract
recommendation.body: Merge after a maintainer confirms that terminal failure text must stay outside assistant transcript history while streamed assistant output remains visible.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the MEMBER who authored the current implementation and can provide the most direct design and validation context; feature-history ownership could not be independently established in this review.
